description.narrative: Degree: bachelor's, master's and doctorate Non degree: Certificate and diploma

comment.narrative: 07-01-2021: Originally a course on adult learning and didactic learning processes was planned for June 2020, however it was postponed due to COVID-19. The revised planning submitted to the funder aims to finalize this activity in the first quarter of 2021.
27-03-2022: Process of choosing curricula. A ToR has been developed for course revision based on the LMNA and is being discussed at the time of reporting.

29-06-2023: Based on the training provided in PBL/PjBL and entrepreneurship the courses of the institutes have been revised or enriched, making them more practice-oriented and student-centered. Please see below the overview of the adapted courses Undana: Agriculture biotechnology, Microbiology, Plant physiology, Agribusiness management, Fund management, Introduction to agronomy (6) Smk Kupang: English, Introduction in animal feed, Big rumenance, Agribusiness (4). Smk waibakul: 3 x Staple food and horticulture; Post-harvesting processing (4) Polbangtan: Production on animal husbandry - introduction science [PBL]; animal nutrition (PjBL); big cattle production/rumenance (PjBL): entrepreneurship (3)

title.narrative: A.O.6. Number of facilities established/strengthened

comment.narrative: 07-01-2021: Investments in knowledge institutes to assure online training and continuation of the project (connectivity and health supplies), investment list for institutional upgrading established, in project year 2 investment requirements will be granted.

27-03-2022: Status: the 70% fund has arrived in Polbangtan’s account. Polbangtan is now processing the administration requirement in accordance with MoA regulation in order to resend the money to 2 SMKs. As soon as the money arrives at SMKs accounts, they will process the purchasing

29-06-2023: Year 3: the SMKs have selected the desired investments and the initial transfer of funds has been made for the purchase of the investments. The approval of the investment requests has been done through the involvement of IPB. The following investments have been purchased: pre- & post-production equipment, facilities, irrigation, and vehicles.

title.narrative: A.S.1. Number of beneficiaries in the society reached with knowledge, skills and techniques

comment.narrative: 07-01-2021: Kick-off 38 people present. LMNA training: 47 present. 100 people reached with the newsletter .

27-03-2022: LMNA dissemination workshop: a ToT was provided to disseminate the results of the LMNA to staff, lecturers and industry members. Outside of the institutes, 8 industry members participated. Newsletter: there are 108 recipients of 3-monthly newsletters.
Activities mentioned to be planned beginning Y3: • Gender dissemination event (Oct) • VCA dissemination event • Curriculum revision dissemination (Oct)

29-06-2023: Includes participants reached through extensions services, online newsletters, dissemination events and stakeholder meetings. Excludes any visitors to the newly developed project information website via POLBANGTAN Bogor’s main website (https://polbangtan-bogor.ac.id/page/general-information). Final numbers to be presented in last report.

title.narrative: A.S.2. Number of MoUs or other types of collaboration agreements signed (education, private, public, surrounding community)

comment.narrative:
07-01-2021: MoU MSM - BPPSDMP has been signed.
There was a delay for the MoU’s planned to be signed by Polbangtan, due to the administrative process in place in the ministry of agriculture. Moreover, COVID-19 caused a further delay to sign MOU’s with private sector and other Indonesian partners. This is mainly because pre-signing requires an intensive consultation and trust building process, which is not realistic without any f2f meetings
27-03-2022: Polbangtan – Vedca MoU Polbangtan – Undana MoU: regarding project and other activities Polbangtan – Universitas Terbuka regarding Learning Management System Development

29-06-2023: Polbangtan – SMKN 1 Waibakul Polbangtan – SMKPP Kupang Polbangtan – Undana Polbangtan – Vedca SMK waibakul – GS organic
MSF: 14 partners signed the multi stakeholder platform MoU to cooperate on the development of decent employment for the NTT youth in the agricultural sector. The aim of the platform is to enhance and structure the collaboration among SMKs, polytechnics, universituies, relevant private sector and government institutes for inclusive, market-oriented education in the agricultural secotr of NTT Province.

title.narrative: A.E.3. Number of staff that have gained qualitative and relevant knowledge and skills to develop and offer the revised/developed study programmes

comment.narrative:
29-06-2023: The same staff members previously reached with training activities have been participating in the training offerings of the third project year. Therefore, there are no additional staff members to be reported on.
The following trainings have been provided in the third project year: - Problem-based and project based learning training (march+ June) - Entrepreneurship training (june) - Hybrid teaching modalities (September + introduction in June)

title.narrative: A.R.2. Number of relevant publications (level, gender, inclusion)

comment.narrative: 07-01-2021: originally planned: 2 institutional and policy analysis; Business sector knowledge products; Assessments of the labour market, value chains, stakeholders and teaching programs . There is a slight delay in the finalization of planned publications due to COVID- 19. These will be finalized in the second project year.

27-03-2022: LMNA report done. Entrepreneurial education analysis
There are other papers/report which have been finalized just outside of the second project year, including: - 2 papers on gender. - 2 conference papers: VCA: MSM Academic Conference. Paper: A Collaborative Work to Improve Added-Value of Cashew Nut in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia. Gender: MoA conference: SEAVEG. Paper: Gender Assessment on horticultural farmers in Bogor

29-06-2023: 2 papers on gender (general report and a Policy Brief) 2 conference papers: 1) Paper: A Collaborative Work to Improve Added-Value of Cashew Nut in East Nusa Tenggara, Indonesia, prepared for the MSM Academic Conference, 1 December 2021; 2). Gender Assessment on horticultural farmers in Bogor, presented at the SEAVAG conference, organized by the Indonesian Ministry of Agriculture (https://pusdiktan.info/seaveg-2021/) 1 Multi-stakeholder forum publication 5 valuechain analyses

title.narrative: A.O.2. Number of organisations revised/developed and implemented a strategic plan

comment.narrative: 27-03-2022: Data gained from collection moments in the research, no final results yet

29-06-2023: The 4 organisations have developed strategic plans on the following themes: - Entrepreneurship inclusion - Problem and project based learning integration - Cooperation with private sector (internships/placements) - To be developed: knowledge dissemination strategy document

title.narrative: A.S.3. Number of students performing an internship or practical work

comment.narrative: 27-03-2022: Due to Covid a delay in the practical work for students or internships. However, there is a strong commitment of the private sector partners to offer internship/apprenticeship positions. This includes a minimum of 16 private sector parties in process of formalizing this commitment. Also, the students have participated in the data collection of the Gender research, with a total of 90 students participating in the region of Bogor, Kupang and Waibakul.

29-06-2023: During the end of the third year discussions on internship/practical work took place among the consortium members and private sector partners. The current state of affairs, ideas and best practices have been shared. At the time of writing the report 2 partners are in the process to set-up a sustainable cooperation for internship support and training in line with the labour market needs and climate smart agriculture. This will lead to an annual reach of 60-75 students (grade 11) in SMKN 1 Waibakul, with potential spin-off for grade 10. GS Organic has already provided a practical placement/work assignment with SMK Kupang.

title.narrative: A.R.3. Number of relevant innovations

comment.narrative: 29-06-2023: The SMKs have gained technical and entrepreneurial insights through the trainings and the cooperation with private sector members which have been translated in more climate smart agricultural practices within the institutions. An example of this is the cooperation between GS Organic and SMK Waibakul. GS Organic is a private sector partner active in climate smart farming practices, including organic farming and the marketing of these products in the region
